children: stablecoin settlement is now live across SoFi Bank's debit and credit card program.
SOFI shares were 4.30% higher at $17.70 during pre-market trading on Tuesday, MA was +0.41% to $570.00.
As part of the launch, SoFi Bank is migrating its entire $25B card program to stablecoin settlement of transactions using SoFiUSD.

"Merchants do not need to hold stablecoins, build new infrastructure, or change how they operate. Through SoFi's Big Business Banking platform, any merchant can receive settlement funds instantly in a SoFi Bank account and withdraw to cash around the clock and at zero cost," said SoFi CEO Anthony Noto.
SoFi said it is talking to large merchants across the U.S. regarding stablecoin-based settlement arrangements.
